A unique all-season style, developed to celebrate the annual Gamescom trade fair in Köln.

"The Turtles' schemes are getting ever more devious. If we are to eliminate them once and for all, we must adapt. They understand that our Technodrome is the mightiest work of engineering this world has ever seen! The mere sight of it makes them tremble with fear, so they focus all their efforts on destroying it—so this, this is where we strike them with our powerful new machines. A turtle shell may be hard, but the shells of an armored war machine with an almighty gun are harder—and using them, we will bring to fruition our plan for ultimate domination of a world without Turtles!"
An all-season style that lets you show your love of all things British.

The Union Jack is a symbol of the United Kingdom’s heritage and tradition, representing the combined identities of its nations. Though some argue "Union Jack" only refers to the colors when flown at sea, it has been used as a name for the flag itself since the 17th century, and its iconic red, white, and blue stand as a global emblem of British pride, history, and unity.
A sleek all-season style that pays homage to the renowned quality of German engineering.

The world of tanks spans many a role and nation.

Whether you prefer to pilot a destroyer,

Driving enemies ballistic in frustration,

Or you're more of a tank enjoyer,

Fight freely across tundra, steppes, or sands

And have no doubt in your engine, gun, or steering.

After all, you know your crew is in safe hands,

When you roll out in German engineering!
A unique all-season style, received for completing the Magic New Year collection during the Holiday Ops 2019 event.
A unique all-season style, received for completing the Magic New Year collection during the Holiday Ops 2019 event. It brings back the Festive Atmosphere to your Garage. No restrictions on nations.
An all-season style sporting the insignia of the mysterious Jatkosota High School.

Jatkosota High School is a modestly-sized school known for its Finnish-inspired school sprite. Despite lacking the stature and resources of some of its rival schools, Jatkosota High School’s sensha-dō team valiantly holds its own against even the most powerful of opponents, as they prioritize flanking maneuvers and surprise attacks to catch enemies off guard in battle. They favor vehicles with high mobility and are particularly good at fighting in snowy conditions.
An all-season style sporting the insignia of the prestigious Kuromorimine Girls' High School.

Kuromorimine Girls' High School is a prestigious school with a reputation for sensha-dō of the highest order. Its sensha-dō team, commanded by Maho Nishizumi, adheres to the Nishizumi's approach to tankery, which favors a German-style philosophy on the battlefield: strategy, accuracy, and a rigorous disciplinary approach that strives for victory at all costs. However, ever since Maho left for Germany for her study abroad, and Erika Itsumi took charge of the sensha-dō team as Commander, its approach to tankery is starting to change gradually.
An all-season style sporting the insignia of the sophisticated St. Gloriana Girls' College.

A veritable citadel of learning with a rich, storied history, St. Gloriana Girls' College teaches its students much more than how to win a Sensha-Dō battle. Gloriana girls emanate elegance and refinement in all they do, be that enjoying a civilized cup of tea or artfully executing their trademark slow, steady attacks on the battlefield. In keeping with the high standards set by their elite institution, most of the school's Sensha-Dō players maintain a keep-calm-and-carry-on approach at all times, never becoming flustered in the heat of battle.
An all-season style inspired by the Girls und Panzer anime series.

In their battles with other schools, Oarai was often in the minority in terms of the amount of equipment. To compensate for the lack of firepower, the commander of the team "Angler" Miho Nishizumi resorted to creative tactics, distracting the enemy's attention and catching him off guard.
In addition to the "Angler", the original Oarai school included the teams "Turtle", "Hippo", "Rabbit" and "Duck". Over time, the number of tanks and crews only increased. Although the students did not have much experience in battle, they quickly learned the subtleties of tank science in the Sensha-do club and became part of the high-profile victories of the Oarai school.
An all-season style sporting the image of the famous Team-Kabasan.

That's right! This battle-hardened band of history enthusiasts drives ever forward, drawing on knowledge of centuries of warfare to deal decisive blows to their opponents. Proudly sporting their Hippo emblem, they strike with both devastating efficiency and impeccable style, making them formidable opponents at any Sensha-Dō event.
An all-season style sporting the insignia of the splendid Saunders University High School.

The fabulously wealthy Saunders University High School boasts a formidable arsenal of U.S. tanks. In fact, the only thing its vast number of Sensha-Dō players love as much as showing off their impressive fleet of M4 Sherman is throwing extravagant parties—and watching their guests' jaws drop at the mountains of fast food provided! Don't mistake these girls' hospitality for meekness, though—their strategy relies on overwhelming opponents with numerical advantage, which often calls for accurate shots and astute tactics.
An all-season style inspired by the Veterans With Dogs charity.

Veterans With Dogs is a UK charity organization that uses assistance dogs to support current and former British Armed Forces members with service-related mental health conditions. These dogs improve veterans' quality of life by providing assistance tasks, companionship, and emotional support. Ferris, a beloved program representative, attends events and interacts with people, showcasing the bond between dogs and humans and the power of these special animals.

"I'll never understand the way that some people think. All that nonsense about health and family being real wealth instead of gold. Bah! It's that sort of mindset that causes them to go half the month with not a piece of coal to keep the office warm. If only they learned the true value of gold—freedom and security! Gold, that shiny material I love so much, is the money of kings. The desire for gold is the most universal desire of all mankind. With gold, those who possess it can do all they want in this world, from running businesses and traveling the world to raising armies and conquering countries.

One day... one day! I'm sure people will finally come to their senses."
An all-season style dedicated to the Gunsmith day.

The main task of ancient armorers was to create bladed weapons and metal armor. With the invention of gunpowder, muskets and cannons came to accompany (and later replace) daggers and sabers. Engraving, embossing, and any other artistic expressions increased the weapon's value. The masters were constantly inventing new technologies and passed on their knowledge to their children. This created whole dynasties of gunsmiths who kept the secrets of making steel, hardening blades, and decorating handles.

In the modern world, the word "gunsmith" includes many professions from design engineer to engraver. Apart from the weapon's appearance, they pay close attention to its technical properties—accuracy, rate of fire, and effective range—as well as create new types of weapons.
A unique style awarded for completing the series of special missions.
An all-season style created by Cordelia Astra to celebrate Halloween 2022.
An all-season style to celebrate Halloween 2022.
An all-season style created by Deirdre Grimmhildt to celebrate Halloween 2022.

One, two, I'm coming for you... BOO!
 For thousands of years, this spirit roamed the primordial chaos between the worlds. However, one dark day, he was hurled through the portal into our reality, along with the witch tank and its crew. Unfortunately, something had gone wrong with the portal, and upon trying to exit, everything got a bit... mixed up.

To maintain his grip on our reality and avoid evaporating into nothingness, the little guy was forced to haunt one of the vehicles. Lucky for humans, though, this guest from between the worlds was no evil or vengeful creature. He's actually pretty harmless—even kind of cute. He's captivated by the mortal world and has developed a love for scaring nearby humans.

Of course, when a tank drives towards you, aims its gun at you, and growls "Boo!", it's hard to tell how lucky you really are.
An all-season style created by Sybill Brennheart to celebrate Halloween 2022.

"Never anger a witch. Especially not when she's on duty. And especially not when she's in a bad mood. She might not turn you into a toad right away, but who knows? A hastily-opened portal can transport you to some pretty nasty and hard-to-reach places.

But they call me Cunning Jack for a reason: I always find a way out. And I have patience. All these years, I've been cooking up a plan and waiting for an opportunity. At least a tiny one, a sliver of one. A teensy little crack that I can use to escape my prison. Such as, for example, a portal opened by a witch in a rush. And now, I know how to use it...

I'll need a new body to survive this other world. A strong and durable one, made of steel and fire. Look out, witches, I'm back in the game. Call me Iron Jack!"
An all-season style created by Aurelia von Alden to celebrate Halloween 2022.
An all-season style created by Caudamius to celebrate Halloween 2022.

"It was our last battle. Our warriors had fallen, and the fate of the islands would be decided at any moment, when suddenly a green cloud appeared on the horizon. My first thought was, 'The alchemists are at it again'. One of the survivors shouted, 'Aurora Borealis!', but the smoke was moving too fast. They were horses. With no riders. At full gallop, beautiful and... Terrifying. They brought with them a horrible cold, their eyes were glowing in the dark, their metal barding shimmered with carmine in the moonlight, and the rhythm of their shoes portended approaching justice...
That's all I can remember from that night. Even though I shouldn't think about it. Among the thousands of worlds we ride in, there is none where it is worth remembering our earthly life. And yet, I am happy to think that the islands will always be peaceful."
You can postpone a war but never lunch. Treat enemy SPGs to this delicious dish with a sauce that changes depending on the corresponding map type on which this noble British gentleman fights.

"Well, guys, we made a nice little mess in our favorite electrician's backwaters. We've earned ourselves a good rest. Come again? When's the next raid? No idea. We're standing by for orders from the headquarters. For now, we can relax. Oh, almost forgot! Here's a nice skin for each of you as a thank-you from the Alliance. Put them on and ride them with pride. Wear them to Randoms. Let everyone else know who they're dealing with. Now, who are we? I said WHO ARE WE? That's right, we're the Harriers!"
A unique all-season style, received for completing the New Year collection during the Holiday Ops 2019 event.
A unique all-season style, received for completing the New Year collection during the Holiday Ops 2019 event. It brings back the Festive Atmosphere to your Garage. No restrictions on nations.
An all-season style made of ice and molybdenum. It was supposed to significantly enhance the vehicle's armor, but has not yet passed any trials.
An all-season style inspired by the ingenuity of ancient warriors.

In the battles of ancient times, Roman legionaries would bear down on enemy positions in a formation known as the "testudo" (Latin for "tortoise"): raising their shields in a near-impenetrable wall, they created a moving fortress that would repel the attacks of their besieged foes. Two millennia later, as Italian tankers forge forward in a new kind of moving fortress built for the rigors of modern warfare, their machines' latticed armor harks back to the interlocking shields of their forebears. The battles may have changed, but the spirit of the ancient warriors remains.

An all-season style developed to commemorate Kupala Night, a traditional eastern Slavic holiday recognizing the summer solstice. It is celebrated on the night of July 6–7 and includes a number of Slavic rituals with fire, water, and wreaths of flowers.
A unique style awarded to the strongest mortals who survived the Dark Front. Applicable to vehicles of any nation and tier.

Irish folklore tells the tale about the farmer Jack, a horrible person who was enthusiastic about drinking, playing cards, and cheating other people. Being as cunning as a fox, Jack managed to outwit the Devil, who used to wander around the earth in human form at that time.

Through deception and trickery, Jack made the Devil promise not to take Jack's soul after death. When it came time for the grim reaper to take Jack, the Irishman was forced to continue walking the earth. He had been banned from heaven, and the Devil kept his promise and left Jack's soul untouched.

Since then, Jack has been wandering the earth, holding a carved pumpkin in his hand with glowing embers inside. This pumpkin is Jack's guiding light—the Jack-o'-lantern.

An all-season style developed to celebrate the beauty of the blooming sakura at the end of March in Japan. Sakura flowers are considered the national symbol of the country, and the Japanese celebrate this time of the year with Hanami parties by viewing the blossoming trees.
Can't go wrong with denim now, can ya? Try this for size and see how it fits.

Ain't nothin' like a good pair of jeans, is there? Find the right ones and those babies'll last you a lifetime. Sure, might take a little while. You gotta try 'em for size, see what fits you. Same goes for tanks 'n all, when you think about it. They've got a lot in common: you want 'em to be comfortable, easy to maneuver in. You want 'em to be durable, but with a little wear and tear to give 'em character. And most of all, you want 'em to capture who you are—your own unique style. Most of the time, it ain't even you that finds that special pair of jeans, or that special tank—it's them that find you. But when they do, believe me, you'll know about it alright.
Time-honored Japanese aesthetics join forces with technical innovation in this exquisite volumetric style.

Reaching the zenith of armored technology does not mean forsaking the foundations on which it stands. Nowaki is a motif found in classical Japanese embroidery that depicts grass bowing under a strong wind, symbolizing power and volatility. Look closely, and you will see this very pattern sculpted across the tank's hull, its dynamic lines and asymmetry drawing inspiration from the ukiyo-e woodblock prints of the late shogunate period. Venture boldly across new frontiers, hero, as the hand of tradition guides your artful strikes.

This vehicle was used by the 2nd Company of the 506th Heavy Panzer Battalion (2. Kompanie schwere Panzer Abteilung 506) and was hit near Aachen in November 1944. It was captured by American troops and then repaired by the 129th Armored Ordnance Maintenance Battalion of the 7th Armored Division. On December 15, 1944, the vehicle was put into operation and filmed by American combat cameramen. This video was included in a movie collection devoted to the European Theater of Operations in which the U.S. Army took part. Nothing is known about the fate of this vehicle.
An all-season style based on the colors and textures of a thickened uniform liner for the Korean Armed Forces.

"You think there is nowhere left to discover. Do you really believe that? Do you have any idea what is hidden in the dark depths of the infinite ocean? What fears can be concealed? What secrets kept under the calm illusion of the waves? And do you... terrestrials... know who guards the secrets of the depths with such zeal? Sometimes, I envy your ignorance. If you ever learned the truth, no sane person would ever venture out into the open sea. You send your fragile ships to the unknown, completely oblivious to what... WHO is watching you from below, and that it can all end for you with but a mere flash of a tentacle. Don't anger the ocean and its masters, otherwise somewhere on your way from Valparaíso to Auckland, you will hear my call among the sound of crashing waves."
A combat pattern, inspired by the Valhallan regiment of the Astra Militarum. Applied in battles against the Chaos scum, on any terrain, for the glory of Emperor!

Heavy assault tank. Developed from the KV-1 in January 1940, with a total of 334 vehicles manufactured between 1940 and 1941. KV-2 tanks were used in action in 1941, with most of the vehicles lost the same year.

%(insertion_open)sHowever, several vehicles survived to the 41st Millennium where they fell in the hands of the Astra Militarum engineers%(insertion_close)s

and were redesigned as heavily armored vehicles with the highest terrain crossing capacity. They strike terror into the hearts of enemies for the glory of the Emperor.
An all-season style that represents the harsh nature of Oceania's numerous volcanoes.

Depending on the surrounding terrain, the shape of camouflage on a vehicle can be smooth or jagged. For example, in mountainous terrain, high-contrast light-to-shadow transitions prevail, so angular spots are used for concealment.

Hiding a combat vehicle in its surroundings is not an easy task. But even if paint does not allow the vehicle to be hidden completely, it makes it much harder to detect and identify. With carefully chosen colors, you can mislead the enemy about the size of the object and the distance to it, which is a considerable advantage in battle.
An all-season style designed for those driven by progress.

"Why stick with the tried and true? Innovation never stops. The old gives way to the new, and it's happening faster than ever. What once seemed impossible is now just the starting line. With every breakthrough comes greater efficiency, more power, and unmatched performance. Case in point? This engine. It's unstoppable, relentless, and built for the future. And let’s be honest—it looks cool. Like, really cool. Sleek, powerful, and downright mesmerizing. Some might ask, 'Is there a limit to how cool an engine can be?' Honestly? We haven’t found one yet."
An all-season style created to conceal vehicles of any tier.
Give "mortar shell" a new meaning in this tiled all-season style.

Now here's a concept: a mortar tank. One might imagine a self-propelled mortar gun mounted on a tank chassis—that's probably what the arms designer had in mind when he pitched the idea to his engineers. Somewhere along the line, however, something went wrong, because the resulting vehicle has an ordinary cannon and has been slathered in construction mortar and clad in a patchwork of chipped tiles that would look more at home on a dilapidated apartment block. We're quite certain this isn't the outcome that was intended, but we have to admit: it has a nostalgic charm of its own.
An all-season style inspired by pioneering "dazzle" camouflage patterns.

With their unusual patterns and contrasting colors, "dazzle" camouflages seem like the last thing you'd want to hide your vehicle from enemy view. That, though, was never the intention. First trialed on both tanks and warships during World War I, the innovative designs were meant to confuse enemies by making them misjudge a vehicle's position, direction, and speed. While they ultimately went mostly unused on tanks—the muddy battlefields of the Western Front rendered any camouflage pointless—they went down in history as pioneering experiments in strategic deception.
They're still in there. And they want out. An all-season style for embracing your sinister side.

There's something badly wrong with this tank. The armor shifts when no one's looking. It bulges in places it shouldn't. The hull breathes when the engine's quiet, and hands press from beneath the surface—fingers straining, curled, clawing. Sometimes you can see faces, too—mouths frozen mid-scream, twisted in silent terror. The metal holds, but just barely, contorted around shapes that should never have been formed. This machine has no need for fuel. It feeds on something else.
A stately all-season style for those who champion freedom.

"Give me your tired, your poor,
Your huddled masses yearning to breathe free,
The wretched refuse of your teeming shore.
Send these, the homeless, tempest-tost to me,
I lift my lamp beside the golden door!"

As your ears throb amid thunderous cannon fire, remember this timeless verse.

Fight bravely, Commander, for those who cannot.
An all-season style inspired by the rich world of manga.

"Ada-chan, what you got over there? Any sign of the treasure yet?"

"Nothing yet, Inna-san. The map says this is the spot, but I don't see anything treasure-y around here...."

"Wait, what's that? It just glinted in the sun, did you see? There it goes again! Looks metallic...it must be our treasure chest!"

"Wait, Inna-san, that's one strange-looking treasure chest. And that thing sticking out of the front...what IS that?"

"Is that a...gun?!"

"So this is what they sent us here to find? Our treasure is a...tank?"

"...AAAAAAA!"
An all-season style dedicated to the mystery (and silliness) of cats.

Medieval art is full of surprises. A dancing skeleton here, an animal with too many heads there. Oh, and cats. Lots of them. And not normal cats, either. Weird, scary cats. Why do they have human faces? Why do they wear crowns, or play instruments, or just look so...silly? So many questions, so few answers. The medieval mind is a mystery to us, but we know one thing for sure: times change, but goofy cats are forever.
A cozy all-season style dedicated to the good old days of gaming.

Don't worry, it's not dangerous to go alone. The further you venture into the woods, the brighter the colors around you become. The glade ahead seems to flicker with a soft neon glow. And what's that sound? The hum of machines, and the faint bleep-bloop of 8-bit melodies. As you draw closer, the very fabric of the forest starts to distort and...pixelate? What lies before you is a glitch in nature itself, a hidden haven visible only to those who appreciate the beauty of the digital world. But be careful. Once you stumble upon this place, you might never want to leave.
An all-season style with emerald-colored armor.

"So, you want magic-proof armor? You’ve knocked on the right door. Spells are tricky things, but stones have their own secrets. Let’s see what I’ve got…I tried sapphires—steady, but too passive. Rubies? Too unpredictable. Jade? Too old-fashioned. No, no, no. A-ha! Emerald! Now that’s the stone that fights back. It doesn’t just block spells; it breaks them. I’ll embed them in your pauldrons, your gauntlets, even your helm. If a sorcerer dares cast on you, his magic will unravel at the seams. Go now, knight—with emeralds by your side, you shall stand strong."
An all-season style designed for the most hostile environments.

"...The Prototype was exposed to a toxic, high-acidity environment for 90 days. The composite armor shows signs of corrosion, with vivid green chemical deposits spreading across its surface. The degradation is uneven—some areas appear almost liquefied, while others have hardened into jagged crusts. Despite these extreme conditions, the Prototype’s structural integrity remains largely unaffected. Continued monitoring is necessary to assess whether the corrosion will progress and impact overall functionality."
An all-season style that is naturally resistant to high temperatures.

The molten flow begins to settle. The heat fades, the fire dims—rivers of lava that once seemed unstoppable have now almost spent their primordial energy. They slow down and harden into crust with a final whisper. What was once a flowing inferno becomes rock, its surface dark and lifeless, yet echoes of its former wrath still linger. Deep beneath the cooling crust, the Earth's heart never stops beating, waiting for the moment to unleash its fury once more.
An all-season style inspired by dystopian cityscapes.

The city pulsed with neon lights, its streets awash in a cacophony of sirens, shouts, and footsteps—echoes of dreams that never came to be. Towers of concrete and glass loomed overhead, their flickering signs casting jagged reflections onto the rain-slick pavement. Steel phantoms drifted through the labyrinth of alleys, their armor stained with the hues of digital decay—dripping neon, corroded metal, remnants of forgotten signs. They did not wait for orders. They did not seek glory. They merely waited for the city to decide who would fall next.
An all-season style with ruby-colored armor.

The God of Wrath was furious. For centuries, his weapons had decided the fates of empires—swords that split shields, spears that pierced chain mail, fire that devoured cities. But the mortals had grown cunning. Their walls withstood his flames, their armor defied his blades, and their weapons outmatched his.

He thundered: "I need a war machine beyond mortal craft!" His wish was granted. In a volcanic crater, the blacksmiths shaped a machine from unbreakable ruby. To fuel it, he bound a part of his own wrath within. The mortals had defied war—now war itself would strike back.
An all-season style with amethyst-colored armor.

Amethyst has been revered for centuries by various cultures for its beauty and mythical powers. Ancient Egyptians used it as an amulet to ward off misfortune. The Greeks and Romans believed it kept the wearer clear-headed and quick-witted. Medieval European soldiers wore amethyst into battle to stay calm and focused. If these beliefs hold true, perhaps a whole tank made of amethyst might grant its crew clarity and strength—though it may not be the most mobile vehicle on the battlefield!
An all-season style dedicated to the art of war.

Painting takes many forms. The hull is but a blank canvas, and war is an ingenious—or mad?— artist that leaves broad brush strokes on it. Shells rain down, streaking fire and mud across once-gray steel. Each hit, each near-miss from a HE shell adds to the picture—some marks run deep, others are mere scratches, all part of the art of war. In the end, the masterpiece is complete. A monument to chaos, a portrait of destruction. A pile of steel brought to life. A steel life, if you will.
An all-season style for true treasure hunters.

Legends spoke of a cave deep within the heart of the Blue Mountain, where golden crystals grew like leaves on a tree. The elders said there once lived the Dragon-King, whose breath had turned stone to gold, leaving behind a glowing labyrinth. Many ventured there in pursuit of riches, yet none returned, for the crystals whispered secrets that twisted the minds of the greedy. But one night, a lone wanderer entered, seeking not wealth, but wisdom. When he emerged at dawn, his hands were empty—yet his eyes gleamed with the light of something far greater.
An all-season style with amber-colored armor.

"Amber is petrified tree resin that acts as a natural time capsule. It preserves things over millions of years in incredible detail. Our museum’s amber fossil collection has over 20,000 pieces, but this is by far our favorite—a whole tank encased in amber.

Today, we know that tanks were a type of armored vehicle fielded in battle. This specimen is thought to date back to the 20th century, a period marked by global conflict and rapid technological advancement. It now stands as a silent witness to the world’s ever-changing, yet never-changing nature."
An all-season style with onyx-colored armor.

In Greek, the word "onyx" means "fingernail" or "claw." According to an ancient Roman myth, Venus, the goddess of love, was asleep when Cupid cut her fingernails with an arrowhead, leaving the clippings scattered on the ground. Since no part of a god’s body can perish, the fates transformed them into stone, which became known as onyx. Believing it granted courage in battle, the Romans carried onyx amulets engraved with the image of Mars, the god of war.
An all-season style dedicated to the magic of the arcade.

It's summer, school's finally out—and boy does freedom feel good. The sun's sinking toward the horizon, the evening sky's glowing crimson above you, but there's only one place you're going. The whole gang's waiting for you in the arcade, and they're all smiles when they see you rocking up. Deep in the neon labyrinth, you're focused, cool, collected. You trust your instincts and your muscle memory. This is what you've been waiting for. It's time to set a new high score.
An all-season style dedicated to the quiet escape of fishing.

It's been a long old week, alright. But you made it through, just like you always do. Sunday morning is your time. For a couple of hours, you're off the radar, unavailable to the outside world—no distractions, no drama. You grab your gear, step out into the cool morning air, and head down to the lake. It's calm, tranquil—and completely silent, save for a few birds singing in the trees. You prepare your line, ready to cast the first throw into the still water. After that, it's all about what bites.
An all-season style for those who fight on the side of light and goodness.

"Not everyone is worthy of bearing this honor. Look closely—she isn't merely forged, she's consecrated. That sheen? It's a reflection of purpose—bright as a blade drawn in defense of what is right. The engravings? They tell a story—of battles fought with courage, of victories earned, not taken. And those sapphire accents? Pure, steadfast—like virtue in the face of sin. She glides with grace, as if on heavenly clouds. Above temptation. Above reproach. Not everyone will understand her. Fewer still will deserve her. But those who fight with honor in their hearts... she will answer."
Embrace your dark side with this sinister all-season style.

"How did I come by this, you deign to enquire? 'Twas hardly a matter of chance. While others were content with mediocrity, I claimed what none dared touch. The gold? Etched by master artisans—a testament to my power. Ah, I see you eyeing the gemstones. Believe me, they did not simply fall into my hands. This is no mere armor, you see. It is an instrument of dominance... an altar to my reign. You may gaze upon it, but it shall never be yours. Not unless you can rise above the masses as I did. But beware, my friend—uneasy lies the head that wears a crown."
A majestic all-season style imbued with the unbridled energy of the Fire Horse.

Upon a lightning-scorched plain, the Fire Horse blazes across the cosmos. His flaming hooves thunder in a deafening salvo, lighter than the wind. He races, sparks streaking through the dusk, as the cycle of the zodiac heralds the year of his reign. Free-spirited and charismatic, those born under his sign bear the embers of his wake, their hearts kindled with the same unquenchable fire.
Adorn your vehicle in this jubilant all-season style to welcome an auspicious new year.

Hanging lanterns line the streets, gilded calligraphy shimmering in the radiant glow. The crackle of fireworks punctuates the night, bright colors dancing in the eyes of excited children clutching red envelopes. The tangy aroma of mandarin oranges, exchanged in pairs for good fortune, mingles with the woody scent of incense drifting from ancestral altars. The town thrums with the sights and scents of celebration well into the first hours of the new year.
A battle-worn all-season style for vehicles that fear no foe—because they've already overcome the impossible.

Rust is good. It doesn’t reflect light, and it helps keep a vehicle concealed. It even acts as a kind of protective coating, "preserving" it, in a way.
Gold doesn’t rust—it's soft and useless in battle. The metal of war is steel. Covered with a camo net, painted, caked in dirt, soot, rust, whatever—it's still steel, solid and dependable. It won’t fail you or crumple under the deadly blow of an enemy shell. In fact, at the point of impact, that steel will shine brighter than the purest gold.
An all-season style dedicated to the Last Stand: Operation Pandora event.

Matter seeps into the armor like acid, clinging to every surface, filling even the tiniest pores. It seems to hunger for everything within its reach—and it can never be fully cleansed.

Sometimes, it leaves marks. As if someone invisible lurks within the anomaly, walking among the war machines, etching patterns onto them. Primitive symbols, like a child's crude drawings, are imprinted into their armor.

What do they mean? A warning? A talisman? A mark of the anomaly’s claim?

No one knows.
A corrupted all-season style for those who have turned the scars of the anomaly into their primary defense and stand ready to fight a new invasion.

They say the vehicle's "infected," and that I've lost my mind. But I feel its controls as if they were my own hands. Mirium has seeped into every crevice and bound us together as one. The armor pulsates. It's alive, and it craves another encounter with what created it. I'm no longer afraid of the funnel in the sky. My tank has changed, and so have I. We're not victims of this invasion anymore. We're its most dangerous mistake. So let them come again. We're ready.
A distorted all-season style with anomalous changes to its armor structure following contact with the Funnel.

The energy surge recorded before the Funnel closed exceeded all permissible limits. At that moment, dozens of Obelisks appeared on the island, acting as temporary conduits for the mysterious energy. And then they vanished. Along with the Funnel, which left an indelible mark on everyone who was there.
Dress your vehicle for the Year of the Fire Horse with this flaming all-season style.

Auspicious tidings, Commander! The Year of the Fire Horse is upon us, which can only mean good things for a tanker like you. Your steed may run on tracks or wheels rather than four legs, but it certainly wields the explosive power of flame. Only once every sixty years does the Fire element ignite the Horse's vitality and passion, heralding a time of bold action and intense energy. Take the reins and roll out in style, because the Fire Horse is champing at the bit.
An all-season style that can be received during a certain event.

One of the biggest and, without a doubt, most beautiful felines on the planet: the tiger. Currently, this beast can only be encountered in Asia and all of its subspecies have international conservation status and are included in the Red List: hunting them is forbidden around the world. Philanthropists and activists from all over the world do their best to save this rare animal from extinction. Global Tiger Day is celebrated annually on July 29.
An all-season style developed to celebrate Lunar New Year.

The Ox is the second of the twelve Chinese zodiac signs and the symbol of 2021. When the Jade Emperor decreed that the years on the calendar would be named for each animal in the order they reached him, Ox immediately set out for Heaven's Gate. Rat joined Ox on his journey, but just as they reached their destination, Rat overtook Ox and threw himself at the Emperor's feet. An Ox is a patient and noble animal, however, in a matter of seconds, it can turn into a furious beast, crushing everything in its path. Watch out for it.
An all-season style developed for the Year of the Dragon.

Dragons are ancient creatures. Different stories have been told about them for thousands of years. In Chinese mythology, there are over a hundred different species, from kind and noble to evil and cunning. Every dragon has its own distinctive features, sphere of influence, and unique abilities. A dragon's birth is always followed by intense natural disasters, but those born in the Year of the Dragon are promised good fortune, power, and wealth.
An all-season style developed for the Year of the Dragon.

Jiaozi are one of the main dishes eaten during Chinese New Year. Legend has it that they were first made in early AD. Zhang Zhongjing, a famous ancient doctor, filled small dough parcels with lamb and herbs, which helped ward off the cold and cure ailments. Thanks to their juicy filling and delicious taste, the boiled dumplings soon became hugely popular. Today, Jiaozi are made in a variety of ways across different regions. In Cantonese cuisine, they are prepared with wheat starch and shrimp. In Xi'an, people make sour soup with boiled dumplings. In Hengshui, Hebei province, Jiaozi are made with pork and cabbage. In Shanghai. they are mostly fried, while in Yangzhou, Jiangsu province, people enjoy steamed crab dumplings.
An all-season style developed to celebrate Lunar New Year, a traditional spring festival in China.

"Among the stars, it soars—an airy spirit shining in the sky, an eternal guardian of peace and silence. There is no warmer gaze than the one it bestows upon us from above. And there is no softer tread than the one it comes into our dreams with. A protector in a skin woven of shimmering moonlight. A keeper of balance, a totem. Everything will be nice and quiet as long as it stays there—as long as its soft paws tread on clouds."
An all-season style dedicated to the wisdom and grace of the snake.

Maligned in many cultures as symbols of danger and temptation, the snake in the Chinese zodiac represents wisdom, intuition, and transformation. In ancient Chinese mythology, the divine progenitors of humanity, Fu Xi and Nu Wa, were depicted as human-snake hybrids, symbolizing creation and balance. Often referred to as the "little dragon", the snake is associated with good fortune, while those born under its sign are said to be deep thinkers with a sharp mind and strong judgment—as well as an undeniable charm.
An all-season style dedicated to the serene beauty of winter.

In Chinese culture, winter is seen as a time of rest, reflection, and renewal—much like the snake represents graceful transformation and new beginnings. As life drifts into stillness on cold winter nights, so too does the snake, slumbering in secret as it gathers strength for warmer times to come. Watching and reflecting in quiet anticipation, it awaits the new beginnings hidden under thick frosts, ready to bloom with the coming of spring.
An all-season style dedicated to the Menshen—divine warriors who guard against evil spirits.

Fierce warriors who stand watch over gates and doors, the Menshen—or "door gods"—are revered figures in Chinese folklore. Depicted with ferocious expressions and wielding formidable weapons, these divine guardians are celebrated for their ability to ward off evil spirits. During Lunar New Year celebrations, families adorn their doors with vibrantly-colored images of the deities, inviting their protection against negative energies and their blessings for peace, safety, and prosperity in the coming year.
A classy outfit that looks great on you regardless of the season. It's about prestige—the symbol of a proper gentleman.

A wise man once said—manners maketh man. Put on your three-piece suit, and don't forget a tie to match. An umbrella cane would be an excellent addition to the perfect outfit you're wearing. It also holds some tricks that might come in handy in, say, sensitive situations.

With the body of a lion, the wings of a dragon, and the tail of a venomous scorpion, the Manticore is a phantasmagorical creature that has struck fear into the hearts of mortals for millennia. Thought to have originated in Persian folklore, the image of the Manticore made its way to the peoples of Europe through the writings of Greek travelers to the Persian court, with even its name—from the Old Persian "martyahvārah", or "man-eater"—giving an indication of its fearsome nature. The ancient texts speak of a majestic beast the size of a great lion, bearing three rows of sharp teeth, mighty claws, and a tail that fires poisonous quills at its victims from afar. The beast's wildness, the sources said, could never be tamed—nor could it be stopped once in pursuit of its prey...
An all-season style with elements that can be unlocked and obtained in Onslaught.
Developed based on the physical maps representing the peaks and valleys of the terrain.
An all-season style dedicated to the introduction of random events to World of Tanks battles.

After thousands of battles fought, you might think you know the game like the back of your hand. Well, random events will make you look at familiar things from a different angle! What's it like to see a plane crashing into your favorite position? Or that one "safe" cover exploding? After all, no one promised it would be easy...
An all-season style to ensure you're prepared for all seasons on the battlefield.

Today's forecast is loud and lively with a chance of arty. Conditions for armored combat should be favorable, but expect high temperatures across the battlefield and take all usual precautions. Be particularly wary of possible sudden breakouts of fog, heavy rain, sandstorms, or fire in isolated areas. Be sure to dress in a style appropriate for the conditions, seek cover where possible, and keep calm if caught in pockets of extreme weather. Stay safe and keep an eye on the skies!
A style awarded for completing all missions in the British Challenge event. It can be applied to British vehicles of any tier.
An all-season style dedicated to the eldest of the Shelby brothers, Arthur.

"I'm used to getting me hands dirty. Doing the stuff nobody else wants to—or that nobody else has the stomach for. And what that means is proper fights. Close combat, bare-knuckle stuff. Whatever it takes. But Tom's had enough of that kind of thing. Times are changing, he says, and we need to change with 'em. Tanks are the future, he says. They've come a long way since we first saw 'em trundling along in France, the big metal buggers. Well, so be it. I'll do what's asked of me. Commander Arthur Shelby, reporting for duty. By order of the Peaky Blinders."
An all-season style to give any vehicle an unmistakable Shelby edge.

"We're not just the local bookies anymore. Shelby Company Limited is now a reputable business—and a rapidly expanding one, at that. The manufacture and export of motorcars is a serious enterprise, and America has the potential to be a very lucrative market for us indeed. So we can't afford to do things by halves. From now on, all models are to be branded with the Shelby name in a prominent location for maximum visibility and styled with signature Shelby motifs. A Shelby car for every household—that's the goal. Or, for our most esteemed partners, a Shelby tank."
An all-season style developed to commemorate the celebration of Maslenitsa.

Maslenitsa is one of the oldest (and most nourishing) Slavic holidays that has its origins in pagan tradition, remaining even after the adoption of Christianity. Maslenitsa is celebrated for 7 days. People consider this week a transition between winter and spring. The most popular ways to entertain yourself during Maslenitsa are fistfights, sleigh-riding, climbing poles to reach prizes, burning a bonfire, and baking an uncountable number of blini.
An all-season style immersing you into the atmosphere of the Master of Orion series.
A football-inspired all-season style for big game players.

Big, bulky defenders. Agile attackers who aren't afraid to take risks. All-round powerhouses keeping things moving through the middle. In football, just like in tanking, everyone's got their own unique role. Get them all working in unison, and great things will happen: lightning-fast advances and devastating counterattacks. But try to win solo and you're in for a nasty surprise. So whether you're lacing up your shooting boots or rolling out to your favorite position, remember: the most rewarding victories are the ones we earn together.
A football-themed all-season style to help you get your head in the game and be your team's hero.

"There's nothing gets the heart beating quite like the buildup to a big match. Everything you've been through on the training ground, all the hours of blood, sweat, tears—it all comes down to this. Once you walk out onto that turf, you'll be hit by a wall of noise, a sea of eyes. You make one mistake and these people will be baying for your blood. Humans are like crabs in a bucket, they'll always try and bring you down. So ignore it—shut it out, and get your head in the game. Because this is what you know. This is what you love. And today, my friend, you're gonna be the matchwinner."
An all-season style inspired by the uniqueness and beauty of natural minerals.

Ancient Greeks thought rock crystal was ice that froze so hard that it became impossible to melt. Roman patricians used spheres cut from this material to cool their hands during the summer. And in the Ancient East, they believed that rock crystals were instances of frozen dragon breath.

After some polishing, this mineral gains a unique shine. At different times, it was used to make dinnerware, mirror glass, lenses for glasses, "medicinal" spheres, and jewelry. There are also legends about how rock crystal has mystical properties that allow people to see the unseen. (It's possible it may help spot enemy light tanks.)
An all-season style created in memory of soldiers from all over the world who died in action.

Many countries observe important memorial days to commemorate the soldiers who fell in the line of duty and in armed conflicts. For example, on November 11, the British pin poppies to their clothes to symbolize the blood spilled in battle. In German calendars, there is the Volkstrauertag: a commemoration day two Sundays before the first day of Advent that appeared in its current form in 1952. In Poland, government members and the military command lay floral wreaths at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in Warsaw. Most events honoring fallen warriors are united by the same intent: to remind people of the importance of human life and the tragic consequences of all armed conflicts.
The style is based on Pallas Iron, a rare "alloy" of meteoric origin with a unique appearance that was discovered in 1749. The meteor was made up of iron, nickel, and a mineral called olivine.
An all-season style dedicated to Mexican Independence Day.

Every year, on September 16, Mexico celebrates its Independence Day. It is a very important event for the people of the country, and it is always celebrated with great enthusiasm. The night before, thousands of people come to their cities' central squares to honor the memory of fallen heroes. At that time, in Mexico City's Zócalo Square, the head of state strikes the Bell of Dolores, which was struck on September 16, 1810, by priest Miguel Hidalgo, leader of the liberation movement, marking the beginning of the 11-year War of Independence. During the tolling of the bell, loud slogans resound: "¡Viva México!" and "¡Viva la Independencia Nacional!". The following day, parades, performances, and parties are held across the country; flags of green, white, and red are flown everywhere; and the celebration ends with a large-scale fireworks display.
An all-season style dedicated to the Mid-Autumn Festival.

In many Asian countries, the Mid-Autumn Festival is considered the second-largest festival after Chinese New Year. It is celebrated on the 15th day of the 8th month of the lunar calendar, and its most popular legend is associated with a young girl named Chang'e. Once she drank an immortality potion and, doomed to live forever alone, went to the Moon Palace.
An all-season style dedicated to the Mid-Autumn Festival.

The Verses of Chu, a book of poems written in ancient China, contains one of the earliest references to the Moon Rabbit. According to the legend, it dwells in the Moon Palace and is often busy preparing the elixir of eternal life in a mortar. Later in China there was a myth about a young girl named Chang'e, who once drank an immortality potion and went to the moon, where she met this long-eared character. In many Asian countries, Chang'e and the Moon Rabbit are the main symbols of the Mid-Autumn Festival.
An all-season style that captures the excitement of a nighttime festival.

As dusk falls and the light of a thousand lanterns illuminates the city, the festivities begin. The moon hangs high in the evening sky, and all below is bathed in its pale glow. From the crowded streets, festivalgoers young and old gaze up in awe, captivated by the beauty of the celestial jewel above. Excited murmurs fill the air, and the songs of centuries past echo into the night. Amid the whirlwind of festive color, parades, and dances, all present celebrate life's simple joys: gathering with those around us and appreciating the beauty of the world we live in.

This style commemorates the mid-autumn festival—one of the most remarkable events celebrated in Asian countries. This festival is associated with the Moon, and gazing at the Moon is considered an essential element of its celebration.
Wrap your vehicle in this movie-themed all-season style, and you'll have the best seat in the house.

Ah, the movies. Sure, streaming the latest release from the comfort of home may be easier, but it doesn't compare. The buttery, salty aroma of popcorn mingled with the faint tang of soda syrup, the towering screen, booming speakers, the cushy chair... Even the oddly sticky floor and the irritating bursts of hushed chatter coming from the row behind you somehow become a part of the fun.
Maybe it's just nostalgia speaking, but sometimes it's worth venturing out to your local theater and paying far too much snacks (or sneaking some in your bag) just to make a night of it.
An all-season style inspired by the American national flag.

The national flag of the United States of America consists of seven red equal horizontal stripes alternating with six white ones. They represent the 13 British colonies that declared independence from the Kingdom of Great Britain in 1776 and became the first states in the new independent country. The blue rectangle in the canton is called the "union" and bears 50 white, five-pointed stars corresponding to the current number of states. The red color in the flag represents courage and valor, blue represents justice, and white is for innocence and purity.
An all-season style developed to commemorate the Allied landing in Normandy.

The Battle of Normandy, known as Operation Overlord or D-Day, was a large-scale strategic operation in which the Allied forces landed on the northern coast of France on June 6, 1944. It was one of the most critical battles of World War II as it resulted in the opening of the second front in Europe, forcing the Germans to divide their forces and deploy them to the east and west.
An all-season style dedicated to International Women's Day.
An all-season style with elements that can be unlocked and obtained in Onslaught.

These mythical creatures called griffins possess the body of a lion and the head of an eagle. Today, no one knows when or how they came to be. Erathian sages believe that griffins embody the unity of the sky and the earth, good and evil. Shrouded in legend, these creatures inspire both hope and fear. Some consider them protectors and patrons, others believe they are fierce and uncontrollable predators. One cannot escape the griffin's gaze, for it moves faster than the wind. Only the most capable warriors are able to face it in a fair fight.
An all-season style inspired by the Wild West.

"This sunrise would make anyone squint at its beauty. The endless plains that it shines down upon and thousands of paths you can take right now by galloping your trusty steed across. Life itself gives a hint: stop, and take at least a moment to behold the sheer beauty of this world. I think that, in these moments, life forgives me this time and leaves it off the count of the days I've lived.

When the sun is at its highest, the fiercest battle and the most important, fateful shot surely await me. And when all my experience, my confidence in my steed, and the accuracy of my weapon all converge in one point, I will take that one shot that will cross out all who dare to take away the next sunrise from me. Now, onward! It's time to ride down the hill with all my might, toward the sunrise and all the mysteries and challenges it holds!"
An all-season style inspired by the mysterious warriors of the East.

Ruthless and silent, they appeared during internal wars and political conflicts. Ninjas are infiltrators and great fighters who operate almost beyond human abilities. Nothing and no one can stop them from completing their mission. Except... Except maybe a shell from the FV4005 Stage II.

"Our grandfathers stood on this ground. And our grandfathers' grandfathers—back to the first generation, they stood on this ground. They were standing here when a rowboat was called a drakkar, and Igor was Ingvar. And here we stand on this ground, among its forests and mounds. There is no force that can move us from here. There is no will to bow our heads in submissiveness. The ravens are circling above us, waiting for prey, knowing we are not the ones to become that prey. Our axes are sharp—they feel the feast is coming where they will be fed in full. Here we stand with our brothers, and from here, we step into eternity. Today, the North will find new heroes, and our lands will get new mounds and bonfires. The North winds, our friends and allies—carry this news to the enemy camp: Before today, we traveled from the Varangians to the Greeks; today, we travel to eternity."
A festive all-season style to make you the battlefield's #1 supplier of holiday cheer.

It's not the holidays until this bad boy rolls into town. As iconic as Santa's sleigh and adorned with a thousand twinkling fairy lights, its warm glow illuminates the sky on even the darkest winter's night, heralding the arrival of the most magical season of all. Just don’t try any funny business, like stealing Christmas, because beneath the vibrant red exterior it packs a punch that'll blow you into next year. What's inside, you ask? Industrial quantities of festive cheer and holiday spirit, of course!
An all-season style for those who believe the spirit of Christmas can never be stolen.

"What kind of person do you have to be to steal Christmas? A season of joy, of giving, of smiles and laughter? Well, I know just the person. Krampowski. He's a talented mechanic, but he's got a vendetta. Against me, against Christmas, against happiness; I don't know for sure, and frankly I don't care. He can talk that through with his therapist. I, on the other hand, have a special delivery for him. I won't stand for his trickery or his double-dealing any longer. No more Mr. Nice Claus, not anymore. I've got festive cheer to spread and a holiday to save. This is war."
An all-season style for those who prefer Christmas chaos to festive cheer.

"So I want to steal Christmas. What of it? Why do you people care so much? That Santa is not all he's cracked up to be. He is a fraud and a hypocrite. He thinks he is so special, like he is the angel putting smiles on everyone's faces, and I am some kind of devil. Well, what if I am? He only gives presents to 'good' tankers anyway, but who is he to judge who is good, and who is not? He has a lot to learn. And Charles Krampowski is going to be the one to teach him!"
An all-season style dedicated to the thrill and camaraderie of game night with friends.

"You are the last tank standing against multiple opponents. Perched on a ridge, you assess your options in the valley ahead. To the left, a narrow pass provides good cover from enemy fire, but navigating its uneven terrain safely could cost you precious time. To the right, a wide plain offers good visibility, but enemy tanks are lying in wait for long-range shots. Your team looks to you, Commander. One wrong move could cost you victory. How will you advance? Will you roll for stealth through the ridges? Or roll to hit as you engage the snipers across the plain?"
An all-season style inspired by Benedict Cumberbatch's special guest appearance in World of Tanks.

"Courage. Valour. Honour. They're words you hear a lot, normally over the wireless from people very far away from here. But they're qualities that will serve you well, chaps, no matter where life takes you. The times we live in are not easy. We don't yet know what lies ahead of us. But remain true to yourself, loyal to your country, and steadfast in the face of adversity. That, gentlemen, will see you through the gathering storms and whatever the next few years throw our way. And, at the end of it all, we'll come out with smiles on our faces."
An all-season style celebrating festive felines.

"Look at the image and tell me what you see. Don’t think about it too long. What we want to do here is record your initial, instinctive reaction. What’s that? Pawprints? Belonging to a cat like yourself, you say? Yes, very good. In the snow, you say? Yes, yes. Anything else? What's that? A Christmas tree? With presents underneath? Sir, I'm not quite sure you...no, there are no presents on this image. And no, there aren't any cat toys or big, juicy fish, either! This is a projective psychological assessment, sir. And you, sir, have failed it quite dramatically!"
An all-season style dedicated to dogs' insatiable appetite.

"We've got eyes on the target. Tank is in gray camouflage, blends well with surroundings in low-visibility conditions. Wait a second. That camouflage pattern...those are bones. Yes, now I smell them. Delicious, juicy bones. Oh, boy. It's irresistible...requesting reinforcements, ASAP. Suppressive fire, air support, everything we've got. Bring out the big dogs. We need to get our paws on this vehicle and the cargo it's carrying at all costs. These dogs are about to have their day!"
An all-season style dedicated to Benedict Cumberbatch's role in Holiday Ops 2026.

"It can all be a little much, can't it? The presents. The decorations. The Christmas dinner. The distant relatives and the endless to-do list. It's not like it was when we were kids, when the only concern was whether your letter had reached Father Christmas or not. But let's be honest. It's also bloody magical, isn't it? It brings out the best in us. It makes us kinder, and more accepting, and more open. It reminds us how connected we are, and how much we need each other. There's a reason they call it the most wonderful time of the year."
An all-season style dedicated to Benedict Cumberbatch's role in Holiday Ops 2026.

"The inner world. The space of the mind, or the realm of the self, if you like. A space where your thoughts can finally be still. No, it's not the sweat-induced food coma you enter after gorging yourself on sweet treats at Christmas. It's a plane that unveils itself when the brain begins to explore its deeper truths. It can only be entered through a willingness to see beyond the surface, which itself must be achieved through dedicated introspection, meditation, and mastery of the self. And we can embark on that journey today, if you're ready. How's that for a New Year's resolution?"

It is painfully obvious that there is no shell in existence that can penetrate this armor. Back in the day, it belonged to Chuck, but it turned out that he did just fine without it. We thought you were just as good as him, so we removed the shellproof component of the armor from this style. Otherwise, it would be unfair to your enemies, don't you think?
The astrological calendar shows that Uranus is in the fifth Mansion today. How many mansions does this Uranus have anyway?
The flavor and texture of caviar is best experienced with traditional accompaniments, the main one being crepes.
G, Fis, E, D, C, H, A, G
This character got his Mouse Trap rank even before it became a thing.
If you apply this style to your vehicle, nobody will shoot you. Really, who would have the heart?
A unique style awarded for particular achievements during Holiday Ops 2021.

"The next day, Francesco returned, and his sad eyes were again fixed on the Blue Arrow. He came on the second day, and on the third. Sometimes he stopped at the window for only a few minutes and then, without turning around, ran away. Sometimes I stood in front of the window for hours. His nose was pressed to the glass, and a light brown forelock descended on his forehead. He gently looked at other toys, but it was evident that his heart belonged to the wonderful train."
A special style that represents real friendship, mutual aid, and a readiness to help whenever needed.

By applying this style to my favorite vehicle, I solemnly swear to:
• Always support my Bro in everything, whatever silly tactics they choose for the next battle.
• Never block my Bro's path and line of fire, even if our flank has no enemies.
• Take damage for my Bro and draw artillery fire to save my Bro's hit points for the decisive shot.
• Cover my Bro by any means necessary while he is away on more pressing matters.
• Instantly focus fire on the target marked by my Bro, even if it is located on the other side of the map, behind us, AFK, behind a rock, left spotting, or has the lowest priority.

And if I break my oath, I will forever play on Malinovka against three autoloading SPGs.
Let's just admire these wonderful fluffy cheeks and soft snuggly fur. Aren't they adorable?
A unique all-season style received for completing the Magic New Year Collection during Holiday Ops 2022.

• A robot may not injure a human being or, through inaction, allow a human being to come to harm.
• A robot must obey the orders it is given by human beings except where such orders would conflict with the First Law.
• A robot must protect its own existence as long as such protection does not conflict with the First or Second Law.

It is interesting that the so-called string bag was popular not only in the Soviet Union, but also in Western Europe. All thanks to its practicality and durability. Probably the only downside is that everyone can see what you are having for dinner.

Arnold Schwarzenegger is an iconic actor and bodybuilder. He is one of the most recognizable people both in the film industry and, of course, in strength sports. Posters of him decorate the walls of virtually every gym, motivating aspiring athletes to improve and giving them the strength to keep training. "I want to be like him" is an immortal mantra that has helped push several generations of people who are not afraid of challenges on the road to success. Nowadays, for many of us, the answer to the question "Who is your favorite movie actor?" remains as obvious as ever.
Enriched woolium is a rare and precious alloy component, produced for us by grandmas using a ground-breaking technology codenamed Knitting Needle.

Core memory unlocked: the word "attic." This is the attic that has the box that collects dust for the whole year, just waiting to be opened for the holidays. Inside the box are baubles, stars, garlands, and twinkling lights that have impossibly tied themselves into the most complex knots again. Fake snow and so much more. And you can even smell the gingerbread cookies. The box waits, knowing its time will come. It will be remembered and carefully opened, and the decorations will be taken out. And after the holidays, it'll be time for another long, dusty vacation. This is the way.

If you randomly find yourself on the steppes of the Hyborian Age, in the ruins of a world dominated by machines, in a tropical jungle teeming with danger, or perhaps on Mars, you're almost certain to run into trouble without good concealment. Fortunately, we know a daring hero who has made it through all of that with barely a scratch—particularly thanks to his great concealment skills. Plus, he is as cool and "legendArnie" as the long and complex sentences used to describe this style.
A special style that represents real friendship, mutual aid, and a readiness to help whenever needed.

Remember when you rushed out of school knowing that your best friend's parents were away and he was probably the only one in the neighborhood who had an 8-bit console with new cartridges? And two "joysticks" (actually called gamepads, but who cares)! And that meant that the second half of the day would be awesome. Those were the times. Oh, here is that friend sending an invite to the Platoon.
An all-season style that can hide in a box or knock some items it deems irritating off of a dresser.

When developing this style, we used archive photos and videos, eye-witness testimony, preserved museum prototypes, and monographs written by consultants and researchers. After a lot of development, approval, and change requests, we can safely say that this is the most historical of all styles currently released. The fact that it somehow ended up in another CATegory has to do with someone's mischievous furry paw.

Now, we see that beauty will not only save the world; it can also win even the most seemingly hopeless of battles. Talent, charisma, and a contagious smile—all in one person. Is that not the very element of victory that we've been searching for all this time?

Good evening! Thank you for using our taxi service. Please note the passenger rules:
No littering in the back seats.
Make sure to say your destination loud and clear.
Do not run around the cabin.
DO NOT use the roof to board the taxi.
Do not distract the driver during the trip: he has only five penalty points left.
An all-season style dedicated to the creatures that roam the seven seas.

For as long as men have been sailing the seven seas, tales have been told of the monsters that lurk in their briny depths: the great Leviathan, sea serpent so feared in times of old; the mighty Kraken of the icy northern seas, bane of the Vikings; Cthulhu, sentinel of the sunken city in the south; and the elusive white whale, which drove even the most experienced seamen to distraction. Let the legends be a warning, then; as you set sail in search of uncharted lands and untold treasures, always beware the beasts hidden in the darkness of the endless deep.
An all-season style dedicated to the royalty of the pet world—cats.

"What's the matter, human? Made you sneeze? Sorry, I do that sometimes. Must be my overwhelming natural charm. Or my magnificent fur. It does kind of get everywhere, I admit. But you don't mind, do you? Not when I'm this adorable. Anyway, you were saying something about a tank battle? No thanks. The only tank I'm interested in is that fish tank in the corner. Those goldfish look good enough to eat, which is exactly what I intend to do."
An all-season style dedicated to the thrill of finding your perfect vehicle.

"The vehicle you drive is more than just an empty shell. It's an extension of your personality, a reflection of who you are. Every chip, every scratch, every bullet hole. Its pain is your pain, its scars are your scars. When you're in that driver's seat, you become one. You feel its power coursing through your veins, all the might of this massive metal beast at your fingertips. And it feels your power, too. And let me tell you, that's one potent combination. It might take a while to find the one that's right for you, but believe me—once you do, nobody's stopping you."
An all-season style dedicated to man's—and tankers'—best friend.

"We found him out on maneuvers up in the hills a couple days ago. All scraggly looking, covered in fleas. Miserable look about him. But the moment he saw us, his eyes lit up. Damn thing came bounding over, tongue flailing, tail wagging so hard we thought he'd pass out. Clearly hadn't seen humans in days. And that was that. We headed back to the barracks, and he headed with us. Don't ask how we snuck him in here. I'm amazed we've managed to keep him hidden this long. But how could we say no to those puppy eyes?"
An all-season style to give your vehicle a rugged, battle-scarred look.

"Take a long hard look at this vehicle, right? It's seen things. Look at the state of it. It's full of holes, completely beat up. It's been to hell and back, and it's still going. Yet here you are telling me you can't drag yourself to the gym today? What we do, mate, it requires a certain mental fortitude. Out there on the battlefield, there are no days off. There's no hiding. So consider this a warning—a lesson in resilience and discipline. Because next time you come to me with a sob story about how you're not in the mood, I'm not gonna be so forgiving. Alright?"
An all-season style that underscores the importance of having the right tools for the job.

"I'm not trying to show off or anything like that. That's not my style. It's just about making sure that, when the time comes, I have the right tool for the job at hand. And those jobs come in all shapes and sizes. Sometimes you'll want something small, quiet, discreet. And sometimes, you'll want something a bit less subtle, and a bit more...explosive. I've lost count of how many there are, to be honest. But I keep them in pristine condition. Because you never know when that next job's gonna come around. But when it does, you best be bloody ready for it."
An all-season style dedicated to a true winter icon—snowmen!

"Hey Frosty, this is a good one. What do you call a snowman with a six-pack?"
"I don't know, Olaf, what do you call a snowman with a six-pack?"
"An abdominal snowman!"
"Hah, nice! Okay, here's one for you. Why didn't the snowman join the tank battle?"
"I don't know, Frosty, why didn't the snowman join the tank battle?"
"He got cold feet!"
"Guys, listen, I've got one too. What do snowmen do when it's too hot for hats and scarves?"
"We don't know, Jack, what do snowmen do when it's too hot for hats and scarves?"
"They change into puddles!"
"Woah, man, too far..."
"Yeah, that wasn't cool..."
An all-season style dedicated to the sturdiest of tankers.

Oak—a symbol of might, of longevity, and of justice... In contrary winds, the greater it grows. The fiercer the tempest, the more radiant it glows. When a storm rages, an indomitable tower it will stand. And when an oak falls, the whole forest echoes, gone its right hand.
An all-season style inspired by The Offspring, an American rock band whose music from the first tracks up to now provides good vibes and positive energy, as well as encourages you to win.
An all-season style awarded for supporting OLS Autumn'26
An all-season style that gives you zero chance of missing.

"No, I can't watch this. What kind of stance is that? Listen and learn, mate: the gun should be an extension of your arm. Stretch it all the way out, turn the rest of your body to the side, and lean back a little for balance. You don't want your other hand throwing you off balance, so make sure it's not just dangling by your side. Hold it against your chest, put it in your pocket, I don't care. Now for your legs. They should be shoulder-width apart, with a little more weight on your left than your right. Hold your head straight and look directly at the target. You already know that the front sight, rear sight, and target should all be aligned as one, but let me tell you a secret: use the eye that matches the hand holding the gun. You're welcome."
An all-season style for those who have witnessed the dawn of a new era.

Stone was replaced by metal, spears by gunpowder, and trench warfare by armored vehicles. Each era of war-fighting brought about new weapons and new challenges. Now, the world is standing at another turning point. Advanced armor, cutting-edge firepower, and modern tactics and strategies will define the battles of tomorrow. The past is etched in history, but the future rolls forward on tracks of innovation. The new era is yours to shape. Are you ready?
Don't go barking up the wrong tree. Show that you're top dog.

Dogs are man's best friend, they say. And for good reason, too: it's thought that dogs were domesticated by humans as long as 40,000 years ago. That's 40,000 years of unwavering loyalty, constant companionship, and fierce hunting. Or 40,000 years of boops, belly rubs, and occasional walkies—it depends on the dog. In any case, here's to 40,000 more!

No creature in myth or legend is more majestic—or more terrifying—than the Dragon. Its form varied between cultures: some saw it as a serpent coiling around mountains, others as a winged titan whose shadow alone brought despair. Yet all stories agreed on one thing—this ancient ruler of sky and earth was a force beyond human control. Some claimed it slumbered deep within the mountains, its breath turning stone to molten rivers. Others believed it awakened only to reduce cities to ash. Heroes sought it for glory, kings for power, but only fools dared challenge a being whose wrath knew no mercy.

From darkness, light. From ruin, hope. From ashes, fire. As surely as night gives way to day, so the firebird is reborn once more. The dying embers of its funeral pyre breathe and swell into raging flame, and the immortal Phoenix, brilliant scarlet and gold, soars to the skies in a blaze of incandescent majesty. So it always was, and so it always will be. Mortal empires will fall, and civilizations thought eternal will turn to dust. And the bird that conquered death will rise to conquer again.
An all-season style awarded for supporting OLS Autumn'25.
An all-season style with elements that can be unlocked and obtained in Onslaught.

After the fall of Medusa, the Gorgon, out of the impenetrable darkness arose Pegasus—a beautiful white horse with enormous, snow-white wings. He was immortal and moved faster than the wind, creating springs of water with his mighty hooves, and no bird could soar higher than him.
Only Bellerophon was able to tame the winged steed. Together, they battled powerful creatures, raced through storm clouds, and accomplished great deeds, until one day the fearless hero dared to ride Pegasus to the very summit of Olympus.
Zeus, dismayed by such audacity, could not conceal his ire, and cast them both down to the earth. However, he later returned the flying steed to the sacred mountain, assigning Pegasus as his assistant and to carry his thunder and lightning. Eventually, Pegasus transformed into a constellation, receiving two bright stars, Enif and Markab, as a reward for his courage and loyalty.

Celebrated annually on November 11 and known in Polish as Narodowe Święto Niepodległości, Poland's Independence Day is one of the most significant dates in the country's calendar. The holiday commemorates the anniversary of Poland's liberation from foreign rule and the restoration of its independence as the Second Polish Republic in 1918 after centuries of partition. Marked with festivities across the country, the day symbolizes the resilience of this proud nation, as well as the sacrifices made by Polish heroes through the ages who fought for their land's freedom.
An all-season style developed to celebrate the 77th anniversary of Victory Day.

Unlike flags that are produced in unlimited quantities, military colors always exist as one unique piece. The Red Army started using them back in 1918. They were given to military units created by a government order as a symbol of honor, valor, and glory. To this day, colors are considered a military relic and are always guarded by personnel. Additionally, they must be present on the battlefield during combat.

During World War II, the ritual of keeping the military colors gained special significance. In harsh battle conditions, a special color unit was created from distinguished soldiers to guard the colors, and the military unit received a special order. Losing the military colors was considered a crime. In this case, all commanders and those directly responsible were court-martialed, and the military unit was disbanded.
Leap for the moon in this celestial all-season style.

Three sages once took the guise of starving old men and wandered the earth in search of kindness. They came upon a fox, a monkey, and a rabbit, and begged each in turn for food. The fox and the monkey offered what they could, but the rabbit, having nothing of her own to give, leapt into the fire as a willing offering. Moved by her sacrifice, the sages revealed their true nature and stayed the flames. They carried her to the Moon Palace, where, it is said, she dwells beside the Moon Goddess, ever at her side.
A gilded all-season style befitting the 2026 World of Tanks Championship International tournament.

Bear witness to something phenomenal, to something dangerous and rare. For once again, the time has come for a showdown between the battlefield's finest. Cheer for your chosen champions or simply stand and observe; whichever team claims victory must first endure a trial by fire, in the most literal of senses. In this arena, where only the elite have proved their worth to compete, the most perilous of struggles are repaid in kind with glory.
An all-season style dedicated to the apex predator of the sea.

Known scientifically as Carcharodon carcharias—"the shark with the jagged teeth"—the great white is the ocean's ultimate hunter. Capable of detecting even a drop of blood from hundreds of meters away, the great white's predatory instinct kicks in the second it picks up the scent. Using its exceptional sense of smell, sharp vision, and powers of electroreception, it moves at breakneck speed as it zeroes in on its prey—before bearing its 300 deadly teeth in a menacing smile to signal its imminent, lethal strike.
An all-season style dedicated to Bastille Day.

On July 14, 1789, hundreds of Parisians stormed and seized the Bastille—a royal prison, the very embodiment of tyranny and oppression, which fell into the hands of ordinary people. While the French Revolution would see days of greater consequence, none were of greater symbolism. The message sent across France that day was clear: the ancien régime’s days were numbered, and hope for change had arrived. In memory of these events, every July 14, France celebrates its Fête nationale, or National Day—better known worldwide as Bastille Day.
An all-season style dedicated to those who fight for a better future.

You know how it goes: if there's no beacon of hope in sight, be the one to light the way. This style reflects your dedication to making a difference and supporting those in need. In an ever-changing world, that's more important than ever—and let's not forget that an act of charity is the most powerful weapon in our shared fight for a brighter future.
An all-season style dedicated to those who strive to make the world a better place.

The greatest battles in life are fought for a cause greater than ourselves. This style is a tribute to the courage, empathy, and strength shown by those who dedicate themselves to helping others. It takes a heart of gold to give without expecting anything in return. Such kind gestures, big or small, come from a place of genuine love and care—and make the world a better place for all.

High scores flash on arcade machines, pop charts rank the latest hits, and CRT screens blaze with neon color. Theme songs blare from televisions stacked in teetering display towers, glossy magazines hype the next big thing, and shiny plastic consoles offer entire universes waiting just beyond the power switch. Coins clatter, logos gleam, and a VCR blinks 12:00. The future has arrived, and it's ready to be carried home in a cardboard box and plugged straight into the family TV.
